note: The contract between promo.NormalizeCode and src/shared/voucher.js. Read by backend/internal/promo/voucher_test.go and src/shared/voucher.test.js, so neither side can change the rule alone. Add a case here before changing either implementation.

cases.why: an interior hyphen is part of the alphabet
a zero-width space is not whitespace to TrimSpace, which is why the rule is a filter and not a trim
the ligature must be dropped, not case-folded into FI -- this is why the filter runs before the uppercase
Turkish dotless i uppercases to an ASCII I in JS; Go never sees it. Dropped by both.
nothing survivable is empty, not an error
normalizing does not truncate -- length is ValidCode's job, and silently cutting would store a code the merchant did not type
